title: Alder Falls resurfacing status
brief: The City of Alder Falls Public Works department needs a status page on the 2026 road resurfacing program as of 2026-10-16, for the city manager and the council, to be read on phones. Headlines: 74 of 120 planned lane-miles are done, 61.7 percent; 9.1 million dollars of the 14.2 million dollar budget is spent, 64.1 percent; paving season ends on 2026-11-30 when the asphalt plants close. By district, with lane-miles planned and done, and a red, amber or green status: North, 28 planned, 22 done, green; Central, 24, 21, green; East, 26, 15, amber; South, 22, 11, amber; West, 20, 5, red. At the current pace of 6 lane-miles a week, the program reaches about 110 lane-miles by 2026-11-30, leaving about 10 for spring 2027. West is red because a water main replacement blocks 8 lane-miles until 2026-11-02, and the contractor's second paving crew is committed elsewhere until 2026-11-09; the choice for the council is to pay 180000 dollars for an extra crew in the West district, or carry the leftover miles into spring. Under "Next two weeks": the Central district finishes on 2026-10-23, the paving of the Maple Avenue bridge approach in the East district is on 2026-10-27, and public notices for the West district closures go out on 2026-10-26. Sections: "Program at a glance", "Districts", "Decision needed" and "Next two weeks".

edit.request: Update the program to 80 lane-miles done, which is 66.7 percent, with 9.8 million dollars spent; West now has 9 done and moves from red to amber, and East has 17 done.
